outcome: Rate of full-term neonatal admissions to the NICU
cohort: 1573 full-term neonates (≥37-week gestation) admitted to the NICU at the First Hospital of China Medical University from January 1, 2009, to June 30, 2018, excluding babies with congenital anomalies
finding: The rate of full-term infant admission to the NICU was 6.8%, with respiratory complications being the most common reason, and most admissions occurring within the first 24 hours of life.
mod_finding: 55% of the babies admitted to the NICU were born after cesarean section, with 56% of those cesareans performed selectively.
